source_excerpt: Min. Via hole size/diameter 0.15/0.25mm (0.1mm/0.2mm only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required) 1-layer (NPTH only): 0.3 mm hole size / 0.5 mm via diameter 2-layer: 0.15mm hole size / 0.25mm via diameter (0.1mm hole size / 0.2mm via diameter only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required) Multilayer: 0.15 mm hole size / 0.25 mm via diameter (0.1mm hole size / 0.2mm via diameter only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required) ① Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size. ② Preferred Min. Via hole size: 0.2mm ③ 0.1mm or 0.15mm hole size with any size via diameter, and 0.2mm or 0.25mm hole size with via diameter less than 0.45mm, will cost more. Please select corresponding via size option when placing order. Min. Non-plated holes 0.50mm Please draw NPTHs in the mechanical layer or keep out layer. Min. Plated Slots Width 2-layer: 0.5mm Multi-layer: 0.35mm The minimum plated slot width is 0.5mm, which is drawn with a pad. The length of the slot should be at least 2 times of the width. Min. Non-Plated Slots 1.0mm The minimum Non-Plated Slot Width is 1.0mm, please draw the slot outline in the mechanical layer(GM1 or GKO) Slot Hole size Tolerance Plated: +0.13 / -0.08 mm Non-plated: ±0.2mm Plated slot is made by drill tools. Non-plated slot is made by CNC. Via Hole-to-Hole Spacing 0.2mm Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing 0.45mm Min. Castellated Holes 0.5mm Castellated holes are metalized half-holes on PCB edges, commonly used on daughter boards to be soldered onto carrier PCBs. ① Hole diameter (Φ): ≥ 0.5 mm ② Hole to board edge (L): ≥ 1 mm ③ Hole to hole (D): ≥ 0.5 mm ④ Min. PCB size：10 × 10 mm ⑤ Min. PCB thickness: 0.6 mm Plated Edges 10 x 10mm Plated edges are copper-plat
scope: Signal vias only; existing power vias, drill and copper clearances retained; quote must select matching via option; no DRC exclusions
